title: Weight decay retune (0.2 -> 0.1)
description: Halved WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.1 to compensate for doubled optimizer step count since TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE halved in round 2
reflection: val_bpb 0.982306 vs baseline 0.982558, a ~0.026% improvement -- essentially within the noise band we saw for identical configs last round (0.982558-0.982786, spread 0.00023). Not a clear win on its own, but combined with a1's WEIGHT_DECAY=0.05 and a5's WEIGHT_DECAY=0.0 results this round gives us a 3-point sweep (0.0, 0.05, 0.1, plus baseline 0.2) that should reveal whether there's a real monotonic trend or if we're just seeing noise. Worth checking the other two results before concluding weight decay is a dead end.
